historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 333 - 29th Avenue, with stipulations that the appellant record a Notice of Special Restriction provided by the City Planning Department attesting that the ground floor area will not be utilized as a separate dwelling unit, one-hour fire resistive sheet rock be installed throughout the area of the social room, toilet facilities, wet bar, and passage leading from the social area to the exterior, the passageway be sprinklered with three sprinkler heads in the garage and two sprinkler heads in the social room using domestic water supply, and no interior stairway is required.
